body: The single most striking visual departure from older 737 generations is the total restructuring of the instrument panel. Gone are the six smaller, square display units that characterized the 737NG flight deck since the late 1990s. In their place sits a clean arrangement of four massive 15.1-inch landscape LCD screens supplied by Collins Aerospace, using advanced display architecture adapted directly from the 787 Dreamliner. Flight crews now monitor engine parameters, primary flight data, and navigational maps rendered in high-resolution color, with traditional elements consolidated onto the primary flight displays and the engine-indicating and crew-alerting system screens.

The central workspace also underwent significant ergonomic changes. The landing gear handle and the Integrated Standby Flight Display now sit squarely in the central gap between the inboard display screens, giving both pilots equal visual access and reach during emergency maneuvers or instrument failures. Further down the console, the autobrake rotary selector, multifunction display controls, and brake pressure indicators migrated toward the lower center console, between the flight management computers, while the autobrake panel moved forward, directly in front of the thrust levers, streamlining the flow needed during rejected takeoffs or wet-runway landings.

Preserving a shared type rating with the 737NG lets flight crews transition between the two types without lengthy, expensive full-type qualification programs. Flight crews undergo approved differences training, which focuses on the revised display interfaces and software logic rather than core flying techniques, while basic cockpit flows, pre-flight checklists, and overhead panel switch positions remain identical to the NG. Unlike the 737NG, which relies on traditional mechanical cables and hydraulic actuators for roll spoilers, the 737 MAX incorporates a fly-by-wire spoiler system that reduces weight, improves roll response, and automatically deploys ground spoilers during rejected takeoffs or touchdown rollout. Following recertification in November 2020, the Maneuvering Characteristics Augmentation System was updated to rely on dual cross-checked angle-of-attack sensors, trigger a flight deck recompare alert if inputs diverge by more than 5.5 degrees, and operate only once without overriding manual elevator authority.

The expanded display surface also unlocks the Vertical Situation Display, which shows a real-time profile of the aircraft's altitude relative to terrain, approach glidepaths, and waypoint altitude constraints directly beneath the horizontal navigation map. Many commercial operators also equip the captain's station with a Collins Head-Up Guidance System, projecting flight paths, airspeed vectors, and runway alignment cues onto a glass combiner plate so captains can fly Category III low-visibility approaches without losing visual contact with the outside world.
en.summary: The Boeing 737 MAX flight deck replaces the six smaller square displays of the 737NG with four 15.1-inch landscape LCD screens, using display architecture adapted from the 787, while preserving a shared type rating with the 737NG so pilots keep a familiar layout.
en.title: Inside the Boeing 737 MAX cockpit: four big screens, familiar controls

body: 737MAX最明顯的改變在儀表板：六面較小的方形螢幕被四面15.1吋橫向液晶螢幕取代，螢幕由柯林斯航太供應，顯示架構源自787夢幻客機。過去需要獨立面板空間的機械儀表，例如襟翼位置指示器與備用時鐘，如今整合至主飛行顯示器與發動機指示及機組警示系統螢幕，機師可直接在統一畫面判讀發動機參數、主飛行數據與導航地圖。
中央操作區也重新安排：起落架手柄與整合式備用飛行顯示器移至兩側內側螢幕之間的中央位置，讓正副駕駛在緊急操作或儀表故障時都能同等看見並觸及；自動煞車旋鈕、多功能顯示器控制與煞車壓力指示器則移至下方中央操縱台，位於飛行管理電腦之間，自動煞車面板更前移至推力手柄前方，使中斷起飛或濕跑道落地時的流程更順暢。

737MAX與737NG共用型別檢定，機師不需重新接受完整型別檢定課程，只需接受著重於新顯示介面與軟體邏輯的差異訓練；基本操作流程、起飛前檢查單與頭頂面板開關位置與737NG相同，長期累積的肌肉記憶可直接轉移。737MAX另採線傳飛控擾流板系統，取代傳統機械連桿與液壓作動器，可減輕機體重量、改善滾轉反應，並在中斷起飛或落地滑行時自動放出地面擾流板。更新後的機動特性增強系統採用雙重交叉比對攻角感測器，兩者差異超過5.5度時觸發重新比對警示，且僅作動一次、不會凌駕機師以升降舵操縱的手動權限。
垂直情境顯示器可在水平導航地圖下方即時呈現飛機高度相對於地形、進場下滑道與航點高度限制的剖面，取代在山區機場陡峭下降或繁忙空域中複雜的心算；許多業者還在機長席加裝柯林斯抬頭導引系統，將飛行路徑、空速向量與跑道對準提示投射至前方視線內的玻璃板上，讓機長能在低能見度第三類進場中維持對外界的目視接觸。
zh.summary: 波音737MAX駕駛艙以四面15.1吋橫向液晶螢幕取代737NG的六面較小方形螢幕，顯示架構源自787，卻保留與737NG共用的型別檢定，讓機師在熟悉的操作布局中運用全新的數位資訊介面。
zh.title: 波音737MAX駕駛艙解密：四面大螢幕與不變的操作手感
